preconditions.description: The length of the string P must be between 1 and 10^6.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'chef' for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string P must be from the set {'c', 'h', 'e', 'f'}.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= len(P) for L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L and R must be valid indices within the bounds of the string P.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b, L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the characters a and b must be different.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of good strings for each query.
